centered_shell_reduction.centeredness: S(H_r)=0 because x in H_r iff -x in H_r, so nonzero sites cancel in pairs.

proof_steps: Choose any bijection U={u_i}, V={v_i}, i=1..k, and set d_i=v_i-u_i.
The support-diameter hypothesis gives d_L(u_i,v_i)<=rho for every i.
Since Q is the squared Euclidean norm in the declared triangular-lattice realization, Cauchy gives Q(sum_i d_i)<=k*sum_i Q(d_i).
